exchanges: Ok so this is going to be a long one, sorry in advance. My golf buddies and I have been talking about a trip to Scotland for literally five years and we finally put down deposits last night, so its actually happening in May.
That's great, five years of talk turning into deposits is a big moment. Where in Scotland are you thinking?
St andrews for sure, and then maybe carnoustie or north berwick if we can get tee times. bilal is in charge of bookings because hes the only one of us who reads emails
Every group needs that person. The Old Course ballot can be unpredictable, so having backups is smart.
ya he warned us about the ballot thing. hes actually not playing much right now though because he broke his wrist falling off a ladder at his cottage, so hes hoping hes healed by may
Ouch. That's a few months away, so there's a good chance he'll be swinging again by then.
fingers crossed. the guy who got me into golf in the first place was my dads younger brother, he ran a pub in galway for like twenty years and played every single morning before opening
That's a lovely routine, a round before pulling pints. Does he still play?
not anymore his back is shot but he still watches every major
Still in the game in spirit, then.
haha yes. ok separate thing my girlfriend thandi is not a golfer at all and is not thrilled about being a golf widow for a week
That's understandable. Is there anything planned for her, or could she join for part of it?
shes actually thinking about meeting me in edinburgh after for a few days because she wants to see the castle and do a whisky tour
That sounds like a good compromise, and Edinburgh is an easy train ride from St Andrews.
shes more of a gin person honestly but shes open minded
Scotland makes great gin too, so she won't be short of options.
lol true. so my old college roommate nadia lives in glasgow now and i want to see her too, shes gotten super into pottery and sells stuff at markets there
That's lovely, a trip with a reunion built in. That's close enough for a day visit.
and funnily my boss is also named nadia and she just took up fencing, she came into work with a bruise on her arm and told us she got stabbed lol
Two Nadias with very different pastimes. Bruises like that are a rite of passage in that sport.
thats what she said. ok what should i pack for golf in scotland in may
Waterproofs are essential, plus layers, a warm hat and extra gloves. The wind off the sea can be strong.
bilal says bring rain pants even if its sunny when we leave
He's right, the weather can turn within an hour.
ok. and do i bring my own clubs or rent
Bringing your own is nicer if you play a lot, but renting saves hassle with airline fees.
i love my clubs too much
Then a good travel bag is worth the investment.
oh correction from before, bilal didnt break his wrist it was his collarbone, i just talked to him and he was like why do you keep saying wrist
Ha, good that he set the record straight. That kind of break usually heals in a couple of months, so May still looks hopeful.
yeah hes doing physio twice a week
Then he's taking it seriously.
the other guys coming are marco and pete. marco is a dentist and pete does something with insurance that none of us understand
Every group has one mysterious job.
lol pete is the worst golfer but the best at the 19th hole
Every trip needs someone in charge of morale.
exactly. do you think we should get a caddie at the old course
For a first time there, yes. A caddie knows the hidden bunkers and the lines off the tee.
how much is that usually
Expect a fee plus a tip; it varies, so check the caddie rates on the official site.
ok ill tell bilal to look into it
Good, he's already the booking person.
hes going to love more admin
He might secretly enjoy it.
thandi just texted me she found a little hotel in edinburgh near the royal mile
That's a good spot, very walkable to the castle.
she says it has a rooftop bar too, which is basically all she needed to hear
Sounds like she's sorted.
also she wants to do a day trip to the highlands to see the hairy coos, her words
Highland cows are a classic, and there are tours from Edinburgh that go to Loch Lomond or Glencoe.

questions.message: where did my uncle live back when he worked behind a bar
bilals wrist should be ok by may right
whats the big perk of the hotel thandi found
what does bilal do for work
a rooftop bar in edinburgh sounds perfect, i might steal her for a drink up there
